questions.stem: Which pathogen can initiate immune response by this organ?

questions.stem: Which of the following complement components directly initiates the formation of the Membrane Attack Complex (MAC)?

questions.stem: During an influenza virus infection, activated CD8+ cytotoxic T cell play a critical role to controlling infected cell, which mechanism do these CD8+ T cell primarily use to eliminate virus infected cell?

choices.A: Secretion of cytokines to induce B cell differentiation
choices.B: Production of neutralizing antibody against viral particle
choices.C: Direct killing of infected cell by releasing perforin and granny ex
choices.D: Release of histamine and serotonin to recruit other immune cells
choices.E: Activated of macrophage to increase phagocytosis to infected cell

questions.stem: A 10-year-old boy receives a booster dose of a vaccine. Which cell type is primarily responsible for producing a rapid and robust antibody response?

A 45-year-old man with pulmonary tuberculosis presents with chronic cough and weight loss. Which mechanism best describes how adaptive immunity supports innate immunity to kill intracellular Mycobacterium tuberculosis?

choices.A: Suppression of NK cells to prevent tissue damage

A child presents with fever and vesicular rash diagnosed as chickenpox (Varicella-Zoster Virus infection). Which of the following best describes the immune mechanism responsible for eliminating virus-infected cells?

choices.A: CD8+ T cells recognize viral peptides presented on MHC class II and kill infected cells
choices.B: Macrophages secrete cytokines that lyse extracellular virus particles
choices.C: CD8+ T cells recognize viral peptides presented on MHC class I and kill infected cells
choices.D: B cells produce antibodies that directly lyse infected cells
choices.E: Neutrophils phagocytose infected cells and secrete antiviral cytokines
